papers.title: GPA-VGGT: Geometry-Preserving Acceleration of VGGT
coverage_limitations: 正文没有独立Limitations小节；方法/实验和附录中的范围限制已摘出。

papers.problem: 对VGGT压缩attention时，宽松AUC@30会掩盖精细位姿下降：合并query使多像素共享输出、未恢复token数量破坏attention mass、早期完全去掉跨帧上下文使不同视图发生不一致表征漂移。目标是在不训练/微调的条件下保留严格几何精度。
method_structure: 早期global blocks 0–8改为帧attention，但每个query读取本帧patch、全部帧camera+4 registers和内容自适应patch摘要；stride-8 seeds后按head级cosine聚类，跨帧KV集只构造一次。
后期blocks 9–23保留全部Q，仅合并K/V，通常merge ratio 0.9；13–16核心块用0.2，因为其中稀疏跨视图匹配更易被均值稀释。
对每个merged/pooled key按代表的原token数量s给logit加log(s)，恢复attention质量。
1024→128固定Gaussian随机投影只用于matching argmax；原K/V仍按选定分组平均。Triton注意力核直接加入per-key bias，matching核不物化完整score矩阵。

insight_math.claim: 完整Q、压缩KV的输出为 o_i=Σ_j softmax_j(q_iᵀ k̄_j/√d + log s_j) v̄_j。当组内keys完全相同时，与未合并attention精确相等；一般keys相近时仍为近似，不是无损证明。
保留Q把attention复杂度从Nmerged²提高为N×Nmerged，主动保留每token独立预测；节省的是K/V轴的计算，而不是任意压缩所有token。
log(s)是概率质量修正而非学习bias；去掉后首帧接收近两倍attention。两个算子消融中，mass修正带来的AUC恢复大于单独保Q。
128D随机投影只需选到足够相似的近似邻居，无需完全保留argmax。只有76.6%分组目的地相同，但相似度损失0.56%；这是一组实测权衡，不是跨数据集精度保证。
核心块按特殊token最终输出的相对Frobenius偏离选出，不使用GT任务标签；多块交互使逐层排名不等价于最优块集。

insight_math.claim: 预测fundamental matrix为 F=H2ᵀ K2^-ᵀ[t]× R K1^-1 H1；H把原图坐标映到network canvas，避免直接把缩放padding后的相机参数用于原图对应。HardMatch标签混合旋转、平移、intrinsics错误，不能等同纯旋转失败。

VGGT probe在encoder≤65.2%、aggregator前半63–66%，block11/12/13/15约69/81/88/93%，显示跨视图融合中段形成信号；训练自由cosine仅在VGGT后段有效，pi3不复现该简单读数。

papers.problem: 前馈模型的像素索引RoPE、绝对位置与等像素训练权重暗含透视投影，换成鱼眼/全景时同一pixel并非同一射线方向或球面面积，单一内参矩阵也不能表示≥180°镜头。目标是同一权重处理混合的中央相机。
method_structure: 输入不是只有RGB：每视图提供从标定计算的dense unit-ray field R∈S²及有效mask M，网络不再读取lens类别/畸变系数，但要求R准确；只适用于所有射线经过单点的central cameras。
沿每pixel射线预测径向距离d，解码X=dR，camera head预测camera-to-world pose；深度是radial range，不是固定z-depth。
在每视图以patch平均归一化射线求elevation/azimuth，代替pixel index进行intra-frame rotary定位；绝对角度MLP也用真实ray角。
最低8频用恒定角度尺度，最高8频按本视图FoV归一化；split为兼顾pose和几何的发布配置，不是所有频率都具有同样绝对角度语义。
点损失在原distance^-1/2权重基础上乘每pixel球面面积，相对同view有效均值归一化；finite differences计算ray导数，1st/99th percentile clamp且weight不回传。训练混合8种camera，每view独立抽lens、2–8views/sample。

insight_math.claim: central camera完整由R:pixel→S²描述；X=dR支持横向/后向射线。它统一已知投影，不是从未知相机自动恢复标定，也不是非中央滚动快门或多视点相机的通用证明。
角RoPE坐标为c_lat=(Hp/m)(1-2θ/π)-1、c_lon=(Wp/m)(φ/π+1)-1；代入ERP中心角恰好还原预训练索引坐标，保留已有全景先验。实际patch平均产生最多4.3% patch-step偏差。
球面积分的Jacobian为dΩ=||∂R/∂u×∂R/∂v||；按有效pixel平均归一化只重分布监督、不改变总体损失量级。点损失还含每sample最优scale λ，因此不能据重建距离单位m声称输出本身绝对尺度可辨。
pin-hole下dΩ=cos³ψ/f²，只在窄视角极限接近常数；90°正方形中心/角pixel面积已相差5.2倍，说明权重问题并非只存在于全景。
发布的频率split保留pose表现，但预注册的严格几何改进准则未满足；constant-angle arm在180/200°几何更好却pose崩溃，故是准确性目标之间的权衡。

papers.problem: 流式3D中的局部对应、结构与尺度具有不同有效寿命。统一滑窗、无遗忘递归或全历史softmax会形成硬截断、状态污染和attention sinks，导致长序列漂移或崩溃；模型希望以固定状态保留多时间尺度几何。
method_structure: 将evidence influence kernel分解为空间content factor与时间retention factor。ViT-L继承VGGT/DINOv2，局部Gated Window Attention配合四个Geometric Linear Attention层。
GLA在layers4/11/17/23维护1024×1024状态，以输入条件channel-wise sigmoid decay更新；不同channel学习不同保留时间，跨chunk不reset。

训练48帧样本按21帧计算chunk序列处理，推理pose windowW10。可选LC检索已存DINOv2global descriptor、重跑framepair、建立约束并posegraph优化；与核心严格onlinehead分开。

insight_math.claim: 核心递归S_t=diag(γ_t)S_(t-1)+φ(k_t) ṽ_tᵀ，γ_t=sigmoid(Wγx+b)；通道证据权重是∏γ，常数gate的e-fold horizon τ=-1/logγ，超过3τ权重约<5%。
状态范数界||S_t||F≤γbar^t||S0||F+BkBv/(1-γbar)需要统一γbar=sup_t,c|γ|<1及key/value有界。固定张量大小保证存储不随帧数增长，但该界不证明几何误差或重定位误差永远有界。
sigmoid逐点落在(0,1)不自动提供无限序列上统一远离1的sup界；将论文条件式稳定性分析和实测长序列效果分别呈现，不能写成任意场景无限稳定保证。

insight_math.claim: softmax稀释证明假设logits有界且相关帧数Wgeo有界，相关attention总质量上界约O(Wgeo exp(2M)/t)。这是该假设下的failuremode解释，而非所有注意力记忆的普遍不可能定理。

cross_discovery.title: [2607.02711] RayTun3R: Online Camera Adaptation in 3D Foundation Models
cross_discovery.history: Submission history From: Daniil Sinitsyn [view email] [v1] Thu, 2 Jul 2026 18:55:35 UTC (10,805 KB)
cross_discovery.abstract: Abstract:Recent 3D foundation models, such as DUSt3R, MASt3R, VGGT, $\pi^3$, and Depth Anything 3, provide strong feed-forward depth and pose estimates on pinhole imagery, but degrade sharply under fisheye camera geometry. We show that this failure is partly caused by a pinhole camera bias in the positional encodings of pretrained 3D foundation models, and propose RayTun3R, a lightweight camera adaptation approach. It keeps the pretrained network fixed and adapts only lightweight components tied to token position and camera geometry. RayTun3R learns parameter-efficient residual corrections to absolute and rotary positional encodings, together with parameter-free tokenization and corrections to prediction-grid coordinates that remove residual pinhole assumptions. The resulting adapter contains only 10,752 trainable parameters and can be learned from a short temporal segment using geometric losses. Once adapted, RayTun3R transfers effectively to the remaining frames of the sequence without incurring additional runtime costs. Across diverse fisheye datasets with fields of view from $110^\circ$ to $200^\circ$, our adapter reduces rotation error by $2$-$12\times$ relative to the unadapted model, outperforms LoRA while using $\sim\!14\times$ fewer trainable parameters, improves pose over adaptation-free baselines while avoiding their multi-view inference cost, and remains competitive on depth accuracy.

cross_discovery.title: [2609.09394] OmniPoint: Universal Monocular Metric Pointcloud from Any Camera
cross_discovery.history: Submission history From: Botao Ye [view email] [v1] Tue, 8 Sep 2026 19:45:58 UTC (2,093 KB)
cross_discovery.abstract: Abstract:Recovering metric 3D geometry from monocular images is a fundamental computer vision task, yet current methods remain heavily fragmented by fixed camera model assumptions and inflexible input schemes. We present OmniPoint, a unified framework designed to generalize metric reconstruction across diverse imaging sensors, including pinhole, fisheye, and equirectangular projections, while accommodating varying geometric priors. To overcome projection rigidity, OmniPoint abandons conventional planar depth regression. It instead adopts a decoupled ray and distance representation alongside a decoupled training objective, explicitly separating the camera projection model from the scene structure. To address the severe scarcity of training data for alternative cameras, we introduce a bidirectional augmentation strategy that explicitly bridges labeled perspective data and unlabeled omnidirectional domains in 3D space. Furthermore, to seamlessly integrate optional inputs like camera intrinsics or sparse depth without destabilizing the network through feature distribution shifts, we propose a robust information injection mechanism. This mechanism utilizes learnable input state embeddings to resolve architectural ambiguity and applies vectorized Gaussian smoothing to densify irregular measurements. Extensive experiments demonstrate that OmniPoint achieves state-of-the-art zero-shot performance across multiple benchmarks, establishing a robust new standard for unified monocular 3D reconstruction.

cross_discovery.history: Submission history From: Shuo Zhang [view email] [v1] Mon, 14 Sep 2026 04:30:34 UTC (21,648 KB) [v2] Tue, 15 Sep 2026 11:44:01 UTC (21,628 KB)
cross_discovery.abstract: Abstract:We study relative position encoding for multi-view vision Transformers under camera heterogeneity, including varying fields of view (FoVs) or projection models. Existing rotary relative position encodings commonly use image-plane positional coordinates, producing projection-dependent relative phases and inconsistent geometric cues for cross-projection attention. We introduce G-ray, a ray-level relative position encoding whose rotary phases are parameterized by camera-local ray angles. The same camera-local ray pair induces the same relative phase across projections, providing projection-invariant positional consistency. G-ray can be used directly or integrated with existing encodings, retaining complementary geometric cues without additional learned parameters. We validate G-ray in three host encodings, RoPE, GTA, and RayRoPE, across 3D reconstruction and novel-view synthesis (NVS). Across three heterogeneous 3D reconstruction benchmarks at 50 views, G-ray leads all six averaged metrics and reduces mean pointmap relative error by 45.8% over MapAnything, with calibration supplied to both. Trained exclusively on homogeneous pinhole images, the 3D reconstruction model handles mixed pinhole and non-pinhole inputs without retraining and remains competitive on homogeneous pinhole 3D reconstruction protocols. For NVS, GTA and RayRoPE improve with G-ray under joint viewpoint and FoV variation. The project's webpage is available at this https URL.

cross_discovery.history: Submission history From: Junyi Zhang [view email] [v1] Tue, 3 Mar 2026 18:55:37 UTC (15,992 KB) [v2] Mon, 27 Apr 2026 16:46:35 UTC (15,992 KB)
cross_discovery.abstract: Abstract:Feedforward geometric foundation models achieve strong short-window reconstruction, yet scaling them to minutes-long videos is bottlenecked by quadratic attention complexity or limited effective memory in recurrent designs. LoGeR processes video streams in chunks, leveraging strong bidirectional priors for high-fidelity intra-chunk reasoning. To manage the critical challenge of coherence across chunk boundaries, we propose a learning-based hybrid memory module. This dual-component system combines a parametric Test-Time Training (TTT) memory to anchor the global coordinate frame and prevent scale drift, alongside a non-parametric Sliding Window Attention (SWA) mechanism to preserve uncompressed context for high-precision adjacent alignment. Remarkably, this memory architecture enables LoGeR to be trained on sequences of 128 frames, and generalize up to thousands of frames during inference. cross_discovery.title: [2607.09503] What VGGT Knows About Overlap: Probing Geometric Foundation Models for Co-Visibility
cross_discovery.history: Submission history From: Filippo Ziliotto [view email] [v1] Fri, 10 Jul 2026 15:17:02 UTC (4,509 KB)
cross_discovery.abstract: Abstract:A fundamental challenge in 3D reconstruction and robotic localization is co-visibility: determining which image pairs share overlapping visible surfaces, particularly in scenarios with minimal overlap. We demonstrate that VGGT implicitly encodes co-visibility as an emergent behavior: without any supervision for this task, its internal representations exhibit a clear hierarchical structure mirroring that of large language models, i.e. early layers build a 3D-aware scene representation, while late layers act as dedicated co-visibility reasoners. In particular, we identify layer L17 as a negative anchor that consistently routes non-co-visible pairs for this backbone, regardless of the evaluation setting, providing task-grounded evidence of layer specialization in a geometry-grounded foundation model. Building on this, we introduce Co-VGGT, which freezes VGGT and trains only a lightweight layer-wise mixture-of-experts head (less than 7.5M parameters) to classify co-visibility from RGB alone, treating each layer as a specialized expert whose geometric abstraction is adaptively weighted per input pair. On the Co-VisiON benchmark, Co-VGGT surpasses the human annotation baseline and improves over prior work by more than 25% pairwise and 10% multiview. Pairwise predictions are well-calibrated (ECE=0.030), enabling direct use as edge weights in visibility graphs for downstream SfM and SLAM pipelines without post-hoc correction.
